title: The Quills of the Porcupine
subtitle: A Chilling Mystery Awakens in Calcutta Dawn
summary: When a quiet Calcutta morning is shattered by an unexpected event, detective Byomkesh Bakshi is drawn into a labyrinthine mystery. As secrets unravel in the misty streets, every ordinary detail hints at something far more sinister. Step into a world where even a beggar’s routine hides a deadly secret.
